paging.name: Paged by gesture
paging.lead: {{DATO: one sentence: one gesture, one scene}}
paging.what: {{DATO: what paged-by-gesture shows: a wheel gesture or a key moves a whole scene, with a threshold and a lock against inertia [redactor]}}
paging.how: {{DATO: how it is built: computed stops, quartic curve, cancellable rAF and a reduced motion that jumps [redactor]}}
paging.input: Wheel, arrows, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End and buttons
paging.motion: Jumps to the scene without sliding

marker.name: Sliding selection
marker.lead: {{DATO: one sentence: the marker goes where you choose}}
marker.what: {{DATO: what the sliding selection shows: a marker that slides to the chosen element, vertically or horizontally [redactor]}}
marker.how: {{DATO: how it is built: the element is measured, the position computed and only transform is animated [redactor]}}
marker.motion: The marker appears in place without sliding
